answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable work bond that vests slowly, like cedar hardening over seasons: the bond sits in escrow and is released only after the agent completes verified useful jobs. A sybil attacker must fund one bond per fake identity and wait out the vesting, so a plume of a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand bonds plus months of idle capital. Misbehavior slashes the bond, and honest work earns it back; an ivory credential alone means nothing without skin in the game, so cheap identities stop being cheap.
